title: Atlas Crossing Partners | Crestview Coffee Holdings | LBO Model — Overview
summary: Full LBO model for Crestview Coffee Holdings, sponsored by Atlas Crossing Partners Fund III. Entry in April 2019 at $162M EV (12.0× LTM EBITDA of $13.5M on $88.2M revenue). Model projects exit in FY2026E at $313.5M EV (11.0× $28.5M EBITDA) over a 7-year hold, yielding a base case Gross MOIC of 3.29× and Gross IRR of ~20.6% (Net MOIC ~2.70×, Net IRR ~16.5%). Includes an interim recap of $28.0M in October 2024. Capital structure at entry: $67.5M Senior TL (5.0× EBITDA), $20.25M Sub/Mezz PIK (1.5×), and $74.25M equity. Workbook contains Overview & Assumptions, Income Statement (FY2019A–FY2026E), Debt Schedule, and Returns Summary with full sensitivity tables.

growth_drivers: Revenue growth from $88.2M at entry to $175.8M at exit (~2× over 7 years)
EBITDA margin expansion from 15.3% at entry to 16.2% at exit
Interim dividend recapitalization of $28.0M in October 2024
Consistent gross margin of 48% throughout hold period
Excess cash flow sweep on senior term loan accelerating deleveraging
risks: Heavily levered entry at 6.6× Debt/EBITDA in FY2019A
Negative revenue growth in FY2020A (−9.9% YoY), likely COVID impact
PIK mezz debt accreting from $20.2M to $50.0M by FY2026E, increasing net debt
Total debt grows to $102.9M by FY2026E despite amortization on senior loan
Thin unlevered free cash flow in early years; negative in FY2019A and FY2021A
Commodity exposure typical for coffee roasting businesses
